title: every and all
summary: Every + единственное число («каждый»), every day и all day, everybody/everything/everywhere.
ru:
## every + единственное число
**every** значит «каждый, все (без исключения)». После него — существительное в **единственном числе** и глагол в **единственном числе**.
> **Every student** in the class passed the exam. — Каждый ученик в классе сдал экзамен.
> **Every country** has a flag. — У каждой страны есть флаг.
> She looks different **every time** I see her. — Она выглядит по-разному каждый раз, когда я её вижу.
Сравните: *Every student passed* ≈ *All the students passed*.

## every day и all day
- **every day** — каждый день (как часто): *I drink tea every day.*
- **all day** — весь день, целый день (как долго): *It rained all day.*
> I buy a newspaper **every morning**. — Я покупаю газету каждое утро.
> I was tired, so I watched TV **all evening**. — Я устала и смотрела ТВ весь вечер.
То же: *every night / all night, every summer / all summer*.

## everybody / everyone / everything / everywhere
- **everybody / everyone** — все (люди)
- **everything** — всё (вещи)
- **everywhere** — везде
> **Everybody** needs friends. — Всем нужны друзья.
> I've looked **everywhere** for my watch. — Я везде искала часы.
> Have you got **everything** you need? — У тебя есть всё необходимое?
Глагол после *everybody / everyone / everything* — в **единственном числе**: *Everybody **has** problems.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Every students pass.~~ → **Every student passes.** / **All students pass.**
- ~~Everybody are happy.~~ → Everybody **is** happy.
- ~~I work every the day.~~ → I work **every day**.
- ~~It rained every day yesterday.~~ → It rained **all day** yesterday.
en:
## every + singular
**every** means «each one, no exceptions». We use a **singular noun** and a **singular verb** after it.
> **Every student** in the class passed the exam.
> **Every country** has a flag.
> She looks different **every time** I see her.
*Every student passed* is similar to *All the students passed*.

## every day and all day
- **every day** = on all days (how often)
- **all day** = the whole day (how long)
> I buy a newspaper **every morning**.
> I was tired, so I watched TV **all evening**.
Also: *every night / all night, every summer / all summer*.

## everybody / everyone / everything / everywhere
> **Everybody** needs friends. (all people)
> Have you got **everything** you need? (all things)
> I've looked **everywhere** for my watch. (all places)
After *everybody / everyone / everything* we use a **singular verb**: *Everybody **has** problems.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~Every students pass.~~ → **Every student passes.**
- ~~Everybody are happy.~~ → Everybody **is** happy.
- ~~It rained every day yesterday.~~ → It rained **all day** yesterday.
structure:
## Формулы
> **every** + существительное (ед. число) + глагол (ед. число)
> **everybody / everyone / everything** + глагол (ед. число)

## every и all
| every | all |
|---|---|
| every student (ед.) | all the students (мн.) |
| every country has | all countries have |
| every day — как часто | all day — как долго |

## Слова на every-
| | |
|---|---|
| люди | everybody / everyone |
| вещи | everything |
| места | everywhere |

## Время
> **every** morning / afternoon / evening / night / week / summer
> **all** morning / afternoon / evening / night / week / summer
